correctness.rationale: The closed radius-two vertex balls are in the unit-edge realization. An interior witness on an edge lies within distance two of a center only if one endpoint is within graph distance one of the center, so both endpoints are within graph distance two. Thus a vertex witness suffices and the nerve is generated by the closed graph-distance-two neighborhoods. The prior same-nerve discrete Morse calculation gives homology in degree two only. The frozen proof also gives a rational concentration check: its free-face algorithm maintains all immediate cofaces, deletes only valid elementary pairs, and the reported core has 30 vertices, 200 edges and 315 triangles. Connectedness and mod-two rank 171 give opposite rational bounds on the triangle boundary. Independently, 27535 faces and the action of all 720 permutations were reconstructed; the signed fixed-face and orbit-union sums agreed on all eleven types. For a fixed face of s vertices in k cycles the orientation sign is (-1)^(s-k), making its Lefschetz contribution (-1)^(k-1). After subtracting H0, the verified traces are 144, -1 on (5,1), and zero otherwise. Induction from C5 has precisely these values by the centralizer formula and the sum of the four nontrivial powers. Specht multiplicities also follow as (dim S^λ - χ_λ(5,1))/5 and were independently recomputed. Both quotient averages vanish since all 144 five-cycles are even; rational averaging after subdivision justifies the quotient statement.
residual_risks: The archived elementary collapse sequence was inspected but not replayed; degree concentration is also provided by the earlier same-nerve Morse calculation.
Induction is asserted over C; quotient vanishing is reduced rational homology only.

value.rationale: The incidence relabeling is a natural, large symmetry group of the canonical generalized quadrangle. Its complete character at this scale is usable equivariant information unavailable from the sphere count: it determines all subgroup invariant dimensions and, for example, detects rational homology vanishing in the S6 and A6 quotients. The sparse trace and uniform C5 induction give a compact structural description; value is not based on repeating the known dimension.
residual_risks: This is an exact finite invariant, not an equivariant homotopy classification or an assertion for the full graph automorphism group.
